requirements.title: Naturalize (De-Plasticize / Realism)
requirements.description: A first-class enhancement op that reintroduces realistic skin/texture/grain to over-smoothed (restored/upscaled) images, with a fidelity-to-realism knob and optional face-aware emphasis. CPU-capable default; full CLI/API/UI parity; auto-suggested after upscale/restore. The lowest consent-weight human edit and the first new feature after the provisioning foundation.

validation.notes: Compose grain/texture + fidelity-to-realism knob; arg-builder assembly
Naturalize runs through the enhance lifecycle and composes into the non-destructive history with before/after
